s00-01-story-8c7dc1.wav.text: Animals two by two. A big boat. A rainbow.

s00-02-talk-b49cf5.wav.text: It's on nursery walls all over the world.

s00-03-pivot-4a0bc5.wav.text: But that's not how the story starts.

s01-01-story-6b6a2e.wav.text: The world God had made good had gone wrong.

s01-02-grave-5249f9.wav.text: Now the earth was corrupt in God's sight, and the earth was filled with violence.

s01-03-story-1cc624.wav.text: And God saw it. He didn't shrug.

s01-04-grave-fda584.wav.text: And the LORD regretted that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him to his heart.

s02-02-grave-f6e267.wav.text: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.

s02-03-story-6d0570.wav.text: God told Noah to build an ark.

s02-04-story-449562.wav.text: A huge wooden boat, longer than a football field, on dry land, with no sea in sight.

s02-05-grave-1b6352.wav.text: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.

s03-01-story-8e1e73.wav.text: Then the animals came, two by two, and seven pairs of some.

s03-02-story-eadb14.wav.text: And Noah went in with his family. Eight people.

s03-03-grave-7c46df.wav.text: And the LORD shut him in.

s04-01-story-6e91b2.wav.text: Then the rain came. Forty days and forty nights.

s04-02-grave-ac769b.wav.text: The waters rose over the land, and over the mountains, until nothing was left but the ark.

s05-01-grave-00a2e0.wav.text: But God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the livestock that were with him in the ark.

s05-02-story-b67a22.wav.text: He sent a wind, and the waters went down.

s05-03-story-8280bc.wav.text: The ark came to rest on a mountain. Noah sent out a dove.

s05-04-story-b0c1d7.wav.text: And it came back with a fresh olive leaf.

s06-02-story-a6e6bf.wav.text: Never again would a flood destroy the earth.

s06-03-grave-36191b.wav.text: I have set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

s06-04-talk-94ce81.wav.text: The word for rainbow is the word for a warrior's bow.

s06-05-story-20d2d2.wav.text: Many readers have seen it as God hanging up his weapon, pointed away from the earth.

s07-01-talk-a86f16.wav.text: The flood shows how seriously God takes evil.

s07-02-story-f629f2.wav.text: The rainbow shows how much he wants to save.

s07-03-pivot-97990f.wav.text: Every time you see one, it's a promise he's kept.
